dataset.name: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma (CPTAC discovery)
dataset.description: Independent CPTAC discovery cohort with harmonized bulk RNA-seq and linked overall and progression-free survival.
dataset.cohort_context: CPTAC characterized treatment-naive clear cell renal cell carcinomas independently of TCGA. The harmonized pan-cancer release contains 103 tumor RNA profiles after the source workflow excluded seven molecularly atypical non-ccRCC tumors. Ninety-four expression-linked patients have positive overall-survival time and explicit status, including 20 deaths and 74 censored observations; the same 94 patients have progression-free survival with 18 events and 76 censored observations.

metadata.source_data_system: NCI Proteomic Data Commons pan-cancer data freeze v1
metadata.redistribution_note: PDC states that its data are available under CC BY 4.0. The CPTAC BCM GENCODE mapping snapshot is also archived under CC BY 4.0 at Zenodo.
metadata.curation_note: PDC000127 documents 110 discovery tumors and identifies seven molecularly atypical non-ccRCC samples excluded from the ccRCC analysis. None of those seven identifiers occurs in the released 103-column pan-cancer ccRCC RNA matrix. The official PDC clinical archive supplies exact OS_days, OS_event, PFS_days and PFS_event fields. The versioned LinkedOmics data-freeze expression member is accepted only after its SHA-256 matches the same ccRCC member independently extracted from the official PDC RNA_BCM_v1 archive. Versioned Ensembl identifiers are mapped with the CPTAC BCM GENCODE v34 snapshot; every symbol represented by more than one Ensembl identifier is excluded rather than merged.

source.mapping_release: GENCODE v34 basic (CHR), CPTAC BCM snapshot; Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.8034305

expression.label: log2(RSEM-UQ + 1)
expression.mapping_source: Pinned CPTAC BCM GENCODE v34 basic (CHR) annotation mapping
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Symbols represented by more than one Ensembl gene are all excluded rather than combined without a source-defined aggregation rule.
expression.scale_note: The CPTAC BCM pipeline supplies gene-level RSEM abundance after upper-quartile normalization and log2(value + 1) transformation. TRACE Explorer preserves the released values without another transformation.
